content: संसक्त {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Adhered or stuck together. .²2 Adhering or clinging to, attached to, sticking close to. .²3 Joined or linked together, closely connected; प्रान्तेषु संसक्तनमेरुशाखम् <ls>Ku. 3. 43</ls>; <ls>R. 7. 24</ls>. .²4 Near, contiguous, adjoining. .²5 Confused, mixed, mingled, blended; मदमुखरमयूरीमुक्तसंसक्तकेकः <ls>Māl. 9. 5</ls>; कलिन्दकन्या मथुरां गताऽपि गङ्गोर्मिसंसक्तजलेव भाति <ls>R. 6. 48</ls>; <ls>Māl. 5. 11</ls>. .²6 Intent on. .²7 Endowed with, possessed of. .²8 Fastened, restrained. .²9 Given to the mundane pleasures. .²10 Enamoured.
